subject.title: feat(localization): add locale context and message rendering

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this shared, cross-surface localization runtime and its Gateway metadata contract as the foundation for the linked localization series?
rationale: The patch creates a new private package and shared locale policy across multiple product owners; code review alone cannot determine whether this is the intended long-term architecture or whether the scope should be split or redirected.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed foundation
options.body: Approve a minimal shared locale and rendering contract with named CLI, Gateway, and Control UI owners, then require the contributor to rebase the first slice around that scope.

options.title: Adopt the full series direction
options.body: Accept the linked RFC and review the five dependent PRs as one maintainer-sponsored localization program with explicit compatibility gates.

options.title: Defer shared runtime adoption
options.body: Keep current localized surfaces independent and request a smaller, owner-specific proposal if a concrete user-facing gap becomes priority.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed foundation
recommendation.body: Approve a minimal shared locale and rendering contract with named CLI, Gateway, and Control UI owners, then require the contributor to rebase the first slice around that scope.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main feature history was not available in the supplied review evidence to identify a single accountable code owner.
